measurement.force_sample_policy: sample every 8 solver steps and also sample the first step at or beyond tU/L=120 to bracket the exact measurement window
measurement.primary_force_metric: trapezoidal physical-time-weighted mean over exact [80,120] endpoints, with linear interpolation from bracketing raw force samples

stationarity.mean_definition: trapezoidal physical-time-weighted means on exact endpoint-clipped intervals
stationarity.precedent: inherited before W4 measurement from W3 round 4, which carries the registered W2 sphere convention; not selected from W3 v3 or W4 values

measurement.vram_gate: record peak and total; require 0 < peak < total
